- [IARC.1.4] **One public header.** `runtime/include/libds.h`
  carries the entire integrator surface — engine
  lifecycle, opaque handles, slot-value union, schema
  registry, fact assert / retract, pump, all typed
  callback signatures and event payloads, and every
  `set_*_callback` setter. Internal headers stay alongside their `.c` under
  `runtime/src/libds/`; four of them — `sha256.h`,
  `rfcs/rfcs.h`, the `rfcs/atoms.h` it includes, and
  `ds_re2.h` — additionally ship under `include/internal/`
  for integrators reusing libds's hashing, fact-stream
  primitives or RE2 seam, and carry no API-stability
  guarantee.
